raw.query: SELECT class_name, requests, request_share, ROUND(requests::numeric / SUM(requests) OVER () * 100, 6) AS pct_recomputed FROM provenance.eda_request_class WHERE run_id = 'eda:j_classes' ORDER BY requests DESC;
raw.evidence: Single run_id 'eda:j_classes', full-population denominator 1,000,000; text-only share is 50.0017%, which rounds to 50.0% at one decimal but is not exactly 50.0% — the word 'exactly' overclaims a 0.0017pp (17 ppm) rounding error.
